info.name: Delhivery — nuit (staging)
info.description: Delhivery B2C API requests for the nuit integration. Built step by step as each API is tested against staging. Set the `token` (and `cl` if needed) collection variables before running. See DELHIVERY.md for the pipeline.

query.description: Client / HQ name from your Delhivery account — required; the API cannot derive it from the token.
Number of waybills to generate. 1 = a single waybill.

request.description: Bulk Waybill API — generates fresh waybill (AWB) number(s). A waybill is just a reserved number; it only becomes trackable once it is used in Order Creation (manifestation). Requires the `cl` (client name) variable to be set.
